name: InterContinental al Ahsa
positioning: An InterContinental in Al Ahsa, near Al-Hofuf Airport and the railway station, with rooms looking over the city skyline and the oasis, a L'Occitane spa and separate indoor pools for men and women
best_for: Travelers exploring the Al Ahsa oasis, a UNESCO World Heritage Site
Guests who want rooms with views of the city skyline and the oasis

facts.text: The hotel is near Al-Hofuf Airport and the railway station.
Al Ahsa is a UNESCO World Heritage Site with landscapes of gardens, canal springs, wells and drainage lakes.
The Al Ahsa region is famous for its palm groves and historical landmarks.
The hotel offers designed package tours and city excursions.
The hotel is decorated with contemporary art.
Rooms and suites offer a view of the city skyline and the vast oasis.
The hotel offers a three-bedroom villa.
Classic Rooms have a walk-in rain shower and a Nespresso machine.
Palmarosa Spa by L'Occitane offers treatments by professional massage therapists using L'Occitane spa products.
There are separate indoor pools for men and women.
The men's indoor pool has natural light and includes a kids' pool.
Flavors Restaurant offers all-day dining, from an international buffet to theme nights and an a la carte menu.
